abilities.name: Zeal
abilities.text:
Whitemane's healing Abilities apply Zeal for 8 seconds. Allies with Zeal are healed for 100% of the damage Whitemane deals to Heroes.

Activate to gain 25% Spell Power and lose 15 Armor for 5 seconds. Can be cast while channeling abilities.

abilities.name: Desperate Plea
abilities.text:
Heal an allied Hero for 140 and gain Desperation for 4 seconds.

Desperation increases Desperate Plea's Mana cost by 40, and stacks up to 3 times.

Current Mana Cost: 45

abilities.name: Inquisition
abilities.text:
Channel on an enemy Hero for up to 3 seconds, dealing 50 damage every 0.5 seconds and Slowing them by 30%. Removes a stack of Desperation.

Shares a cooldown with Clemency.

abilities.name: Searing Lash
abilities.text:
After 0.5 seconds, smite enemies in a straight line for 82 damage.

If the first strike hits an enemy Hero, a second strike will occur after a short delay.

Repeatable Quest: Hit Heroes with Searing Lash.
Repeatable Quest: Hit 3 Heroes with Basic Attacks.

Reward: Permanently increase Whitemane's maximum Health by 3 and Mana by 2. Heroes hit with the second strike of Searing Lash count as 2 hits.

abilities.name: Scarlet Aegis
abilities.text: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Divine Reckoning
abilities.text: After 1 second, consecrate an area for 4 seconds, dealing 50 damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies inside. 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes is returned as Mana.

1.name: Pity the Frail
1.text: For every Hero hit with Searing Lash, lower the cooldown of Inquisition by 1 seconds. Allies below 30% Health receive 25% more healing from Whitemane.

1.name: Righteous Flame
1.text: Searing Lash deals 25% more damage to enemies. If the second strike hits an enemy Hero, they take an additional 25% damage and Whitemane gains 40% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

1.name: Inquisitor's Prayer
1.text: Searing Lash restores 25 Mana for each Hero it hits, and Zeal lasts 2 additional seconds.

4.name: Unwavering Faith
4.text: Increase Whitemane's Basic Attack range by 1.1. Whitemane gains 20% increased Basic Attack damage for each active Zeal buff.

4.name: Martyrdom
4.text: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

4.name: Indulgence
4.text: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Increase this by an additional 5% for each active Zeal.

7.name: Zealous Spirit
7.text: Upon reaching 2 stacks of Desperation, Whitemane gains Zeal.

7.name: Saintly Greatstaff
7.text: Enemy Heroes hit by Searing Lash are marked for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 55 Spell damage and remove the mark.

7.name: Intercession
7.text: Activate to make an ally Unstoppable for 1 second.

10.name: Scarlet Aegis
10.text: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

10.name: Divine Reckoning
10.text: After 1 second, consecrate an area for 4 seconds, dealing 50 damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies inside. 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes is returned as Mana.

13.name: Subjugation
13.text: Inquisition reduces all damage the target deals by 50%.

13.name: Lashing Out
13.text: If Searing Lash's second strike hits an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown to 1 second.

13.name: Scarlet Wrath
13.text: Basic Attacks against Heroes increase the duration of all active Zeals by 0.75 seconds, restore 1% Mana to all Zeal targets, and lower the cooldown of Zeals activation by 4 seconds.

16.name: Radiance
16.text: Reaching 3 stacks of Desperation heals for 190 and reapplies Zeal to allies with Zeal.

16.name: Shared Punishment
16.text: Upon casting, Inquisition can chain to an additional enemy Hero near its target, dealing 50 damage every 0.5 seconds. Affected enemies lose 10 Armor.

16.name: Harsh Discipline
16.text:
Hitting a Hero with Searing Lash while they are being targeted by Inquisition Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

Passive: Reduce Inquisition's cooldown by 2 seconds.

20.name: Scarlet Crusade
20.text: Scarlet Aegis heals for 50% more and makes affected allies Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

20.name: Judgment Day
20.text: Divine Reckoning deals 50% more damage and pulls enemies to its center the first time it hits them.

20.name: Guiding Light
20.text:
Activate to cast a permanent Zeal on an allied Hero that costs no Mana and doesn't grant Desperation. Only one can be active at a time and has global cast range.

Increases the Spell Power bonus provided by Whitemane's trait by 15%.

20.name: Purge the Wicked
20.text: Activate to blast an enemy Hero with holy fire, reducing their Armor by 25 and dealing 300 damage over 4 seconds.
